caption:
You push the thought of death away every single time it arrives.

Nachiketa chose the hardest question — would you? Comment: FACE IT or AVOID IT. That's one god-meeting inside you. Every fear hides another door. Follow Gods of the Mind and we'll open them together, one at a time, until you see the whole map of yourself.
